title: PQC and AEAD wrappers
property: mlDsaVerify and mlDsaVerifyKey never throw and accept only the exact (key, message, signature) signed in this run; aes256gcmOpen never throws and returns the plaintext only for the exact sealed (key, iv, aad, ciphertext, tag), null otherwise; mlKemDecaps throws Error only on a ciphertext that is not 1,088 bytes and returns the encapsulated secret exactly for the untouched ciphertext (implicit rejection otherwise); hkdfSha256Expand throws Error exactly for an output length outside [1, 8160] or a PRK under 32 bytes and otherwise equals Node's HKDF

slow.basis: max(1000 ms, 100 x median call time of the first 200 cases); not a timing result

callTimeMs.note: time of the call(s) under test, for the slow-input detector only; not a timing result (untimed series, no quiet-machine protocol)
